**Content Quality:**
This is a strong, well-structured CV with clear section headings, relevant progression from Counter Assistant to Butcher, quantified production and customer-service results, and a professional presentation. The profile quickly establishes the candidate’s experience, butcher training, HACCP certification and core technical capabilities. The experience section is especially credible and impactful: carcass volumes, weekly sausage production, customer volume, apprentice training, the award-winning ćevapi, dry-ageing trial and wedding orders provide useful evidence rather than generic claims. The CV also handles the master butcher exam accurately by stating that it is planned and not yet passed. The job title and required terminology are represented clearly. A small ATS/alignment opportunity remains: the ad explicitly mentions packaging fresh meat, while the CV does not state the candidate’s supported experience of wrapping customer orders in paper. It demonstrates completed butcher training, substantially more than two years of meat-counter experience, HACCP knowledge, cutting and portioning, customer advice, FIFO stock rotation, temperature checks, hygiene routines and cash handling. The CV appropriately does not claim one. The document also does not show supermarket-specific experience with self-service shelves, tray sealers or labelling scales; the candidate’s material confirms that this experience is not held, so this is not a CV defect that should be disguised. The candidate’s preparation for the Master Butcher exam is a positive development point and is accurately presented.

# Butcher / Meat Counter Assistant (m/f/d) – Zagreb-Jarun store

**Company:** FreshCart Supermarkets (FICTIONAL)
**Location:** Zagreb, Croatia (on-site, Zagreb-Jarun store)
**Employment:** Full-time, 40 h/week, permanent after a 6-month probation period

Pay: €1,250–€1,450 gross/month + €100 shift allowance & 25% Sunday bonus.
Shifts: early 06:00–14:00 or late 13:00–21:00, alternating weekly; every 2nd Saturday.

## What you'll do

- Cut, portion & package fresh meat for the service counter and self-service shelves
- Advise customers on cuts, quantities and preparation
- Keep the counter ≥ 95% stocked at peak hours; rotate stock (FIFO)
- Record temperature & hygiene checks (HACCP)

## What we ask

- Completed butcher training or ≥ 2 years at a meat counter
- HACCP knowledge
- Forklift licence is a plus (deliveries arrive on pallets)

Apply with CV & short letter to jobs@freshcart.example

company_info.company_description:
FreshCart Supermarkets is a Croatian supermarket chain founded in 2008, operating 46 neighbourhood stores across Zagreb, Zagreb County and Karlovac County. It employs around 1,900 people and is especially focused on fresh food: larger stores have staffed meat and deli counters, supplied through its own Velika Gorica distribution centre. Around 60% of its fresh meat comes from Croatian producers.

The company’s stated priorities are fresh local food, fair prices and knowledgeable, helpful staff. Its “Ask the counter” promise reflects a culture of honest product advice and customer service, supported by training for counter employees. FreshCart values reliability, hygiene, friendliness and pride in good work; for counter roles, practical experience can matter more than formal qualifications.

Store teams work across shifts, with new colleagues receiving an introduction alongside an experienced butcher and a paid HACCP refresher. The company also supports relevant skills development, including equipment courses and preparation for the master craftsman exam. Employee feedback notes that schedules are shared in advance, shift swaps may be arranged, and Saturdays can be busy. Benefits include a meal allowance, staff discount, Christmas bonus and public-transport allowance.

PROFESSIONAL PROFILE
Butcher and meat-counter professional with experience since 2015 in carcass breakdown, boning, trimming, portioning and customer service. Confident advising customers on cuts and preparation, making fresh sausages, and maintaining cold-chain temperature and hygiene checks. Completed vocational butcher training and holds a renewed basic HACCP certificate.

KEY SKILLS
Carcass breakdown (beef, pork and lamb) · Boning, trimming and portioning · Fresh sausage production · Customer advice on cuts and preparation · FIFO stock rotation · Cold-chain temperature checks · HACCP and hygiene routines · Knife sharpening · Mincer and bandsaw operation · Cash handling

Vocational Certificate: Butcher (3-year programme) | Food Trades School Zagreb | 2015

Croatian (native) · English (good; customer communication) · German (basic)
